$Comment: The Emerald Wilds campaign's front door: handed out at the Adventurer's Guide hub and finished
in front of Ranger Wren, out in the Wilds.
Npc.ViewId and the hand-in are deliberately two different characters, which is what makes this
read as 'go and find her'. The single step is a TURN_IN with a blank Target, so nothing has to
be carried; arriving and speaking is the whole task, and Wren's own greeting closes it.
Requires keeps it behind the plugin's own gather_the_basics tutorial, so a brand new player
learns the basics before the campaign picks up.
The _Wilds folder is what puts the wilds_ in front of this file's id, so the file can be named
for the beat rather than for the questline. Rename the folder and every id under it changes,
The starter kit is granted as item rewards rather than as /give commands, so a full bag holds
the payout back instead of dropping it on the floor. The prospecting pick is this pack's own
item: retune or swap it by editing Server/Item/Items/Wilds_Prospectors_Pick.json, or drop the
reward row to hand out a vanilla tool instead.
